area_defaults.comment: Areas map the post-merge source tree (one package, src/scholar_*) to the tests that exercise it. A path matched by an area takes that area's gate; E3 task path rules apply only to paths no area matches (explicit --task still works). The first matching area wins, so specific areas precede catch-alls. Inner skips @pytest.mark.slow; checkpoint runs the area's tests and their direct consumers, slow ones included. pr is the checkpoint plus lint ("@checkpoint" stands for the area's checkpoint commands): since H-gate-and-ci (2026-11-23) the full suites run in CI, and locally only at closure or when a path matches no area, always through scripts/suite_lock.py. Every Python test file must be named by some area's inner or checkpoint commands (select_test_gate.py --check).
